params.name: pageSize
params.description: The maximum number of results to return per page.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: A token returned from a previous list request to retrieve the next page of results.

items.docs: Retrieves a paginated list of subscriptions configured in your Zylo account. Subscriptions represent configured instances of SaaS applications and typically have a 1:1 relationship with a given application.

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: The unique identifier of the subscription.

items.docs: Retrieves details for a specific subscription by its ID.
